findingDetails.title: The spec-gate advise path never acknowledges delivery, so the notice repeats on every shell call
process_start is keyed by its bare name while every other map key is qualified
The session-cleanup hook imports another runtime's plugin outside the fail-open wrapper
The dispatch preflight passes the raw payload cwd to the rule engine

results.notes: Payload reads match the recorded wire format for tool_name, tool_input.command, tool_input.file_path, session_id, parent_session_id and transcript_path. The pre_tool advise reply field is not covered by the record.
The review target is a hook and plugin surface with no checklist document of its own.

noveltyJustification: All four findings are new: none appears in the 29 dispositions in 023-vibe-review-remediation/implementation-summary.md. The closest prior findings (R4-P2-001--e3447f5b13ad, R4-P2-002--c3535226947a) were documentation fixes in guards-and-hooks.md, while R1-P1-001 is a code defect in the adapter's use of the core contract.
ruledOut: Journal segment ordering in the session reader: zero-padded journal names make the lexicographic sort correct
deep-loop-guard reading the wrong subagent field: tool_input.config_name is confirmed by guards-and-hooks.md:126 and VIB-HK-024
toCoreCall reading the wrong write path field: tool_input.file_path is confirmed by the wire-format fixture
spec-gate and spec-gate-classify keying different state files: both resolve to the same key
git-message-gate having no kill switch: documented as deliberate at lines 8-9
